text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three years I raced through alongside Mejiro Ramonu came to an end, and one day, after things had settled down a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our training as usual,
I held a brief meeting with Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—I happen to be free
on that day.
choice_data_list: Then I'll get in touch with the reporter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After telling her that, I open my organizer and a
certain ticket catches my eye. It was the "Hot Springs
Trip Voucher" I won at the shopping district raffle...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I kept missing the chance, so I had it tucked away.
Right now there's a gap between plans,
so we finally have time to relax."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...If it is at the very end
of reaching the supreme race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Talking it out doesn't sound too bad.
At least until our flushed skin cools down..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall her words after winning the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket".
Perhaps...
now she might be interested.
choice_data_list: Ramonu, do you like hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
shall we do that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Which bathhouse
is for us tonight?
choice_data_list: ...If you're going, I'll give you a ticket!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why? You should just keep it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I mean...
who else would carry the luggage?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And so...
with all the casualness of heading to the dorm showers,
we arrived at a hot spring that very day.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm.
choice_data_list: This looks like a great spot!
This looks like a great spot, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: She looks happy.
choice_data_list: It's been so long since I've been to a hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You really do like it, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I could have let you use
our family's hot springs, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the prestigious Mejiro family,
it seems they even own hot springs.
Though, that's not quite the point...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Traveling with hot springs as the sole purpose, spending quiet time chatting with friends... To me, hot springs are intertwined with memories.
choice_data_list: It'll make you happy when you look back on it later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: ...Um, in racing terms that would be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You want me
to understand, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
However,
that is completely unnecessary effort.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
see you later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking a relaxing soak in the hot spring,
I stepped outside to find Mejiro Ramonu was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked around, but they were nowhere in the inn.
So I decided to ask one of the staff members
who was cleaning nearby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An idea suddenly strikes me, making me cut my words short.
Mejiro Ramonu hadn't simply gone home...
choice_data_list: Is there anywhere around here where I can run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze,
the entire sky was twinkling with stars.
Taken aback by its beauty, I let out a breath of awe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I told you so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That it's a pointless effort.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because,
I have known that for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you love racing...
you will witness a magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To know the zenith.
To feel exquisite beauty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—Giving love
fills me with delight.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, ever since I met her...
the past, the future, and even right now.
It's all been about Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we have the luxury...
to be reminiscing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To that heart,
overflowing with love—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Mejiro Ramonu...
